scope_notes.scanned_records: Promoted main corpus records, not deduplicated unique works.
scope_notes.accepted_records: Promoted main corpus records with accepted status, without identity deduplication.
scope_notes.prefilter_candidates: Raw candidate record count in the promoted main prefilter output, without identity deduplication.
scope_notes.candidate_papers: Unique keep plus borderline papers in the promoted main triage output.
scope_notes.deep_analysis_papers: Unique papers with cards in the standing Stage 5 aggregate, including boundary and reference papers; not seed targets or PDF counts.
scope_notes.identity: Triage uses source-scoped IDs or links, with title, venue and year as fallback. Cards use links and normalized titles or curated aliases. Conflicting duplicate verdicts are rejected.
scope_notes.provenance: SHA-256 hashes cover the exact input bytes. Pending impact runs, cache directories and summary counts are excluded. This is a snapshot, not a live counter.
